latest_post.title: $PBR and $HPE
latest_post.body:
So $PBR  hit around 5%. Just $100 of profit. I will throw it into $ SCHD for now. I won’t post that trade individually.

So sold this position. 

I’ve retained one share to watch. I will likely swing back into it later

$HPE is coming down towards the end of the week.

So tempting just to hop directly into my shares. 

But old habits, die hard. I will go ahead and be greedy. 

I will sell a cash secured put to get into the shares. I just need this downward trend to persist into the weekend past Friday’s close.

It’s a slow mover. So hopefully will not pop back up too quickly. But I would be happy with getting in at a $55 price target or less. It does pay a dividend. I will continue to ride it as it inches higher, which I expected to do so towards the end of the year.
